title: Small-n (n=3) Western blot replicates with wide spread
what: apparent +0.27 (+26.6%) mean increase across n=3 replicates, inconclusive due to wide overlap

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Inhibitor averages 1.28 vs vehicle 1.01 (+0.27 / +27%), but the pilot is inconclusive.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: No; with n=3 per arm, individual replicates overlap (95% CIs 0.05–2.51 vs 0.19–1.83).

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Two of the three inhibitor replicates fall inside the vehicle range; one high replicate (1.84) drives the mean.
